Executes the margin swap on the hook pool with `hookData`           (the hook flash-expands the swap by the borrow and records the           position in afterSwap).        2. Pulls the trader's MARGIN and settles it (router's -margin delta).        3. Mints the swap OUTPUT as an ERC-6909 claim held by the HOOK           (collateral custodian), offsetting the router's +output delta.        4. Pulls the SOLVER's borrow and settles it FOR THE HOOK via           settleFor(hook), zeroing the hook's flash-provided -borrow delta.        5. Registers the on-chain SolverDebt guaranteeing solver repayment. params.minAmountOut: Minimum swap output for the liquidation unwind (slippage                     protection against MEV); derive it from an oracle quote.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

quoteExactInput((address,address,uint24,.details: Spot-depth approximation based on the real on-chain slot0 price.

rebalance(address,(address,address,uint2.details: Re-centers an out-of-range position's concentrated liquidity around the      current tick. Safe to run permissionless: it only moves liquidity ranges,      is a no-op when the tick is already in range, and the caller pays gas.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.
